label: Late original-phase m/x/z/s/3 or <DEL>, in sequences starting with q/w/y/u/2
explanation: Fires only in the original phase at t>=3 and on the <DEL> step; it never fires in the copy phase or at t<3. About 45% of activation mass is on <DEL>. The rest is mostly on first occurrences of m, x, z, s, 3. It depends heavily on what came earlier: the first original token is usually q (7x lift), w, y, u or 2, and the prefix is rich in q/w/y/u/2/b/d/0/a/k. The larger activations sit in sequences that start with q and have prefixes full of these tokens. It is mostly silent when the prefix holds many other letters (i, g, j, n, o, p, h, c, e, l), and rarely fires on a repeated input token. The conjunction gets about 0.46 F1 on dev. The real condition looks like a graded weighting over the prefix that no simple set rule captures.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=q (+4.48), orig0=w (+3.46), orig0=y (+3.45), orig0=u (+3.32), orig0=2 (+2.96), orig1=q (+2.95). Lower it: phase=2 (-8.68), prev3_tok=- (-7.29), orig1=z (-4.09), orig1=x (-3.71).
